description: Chief Secretary's Office of the Southern Province - The Regulations of the Co-operative Employees' Pension Scheme Statute-2019 of the Southern province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment and regulation of a pension scheme for cooperative employees under the Southern Provincial Council. It contains detailed regulations, eligibility criteria, contribution requirements, and administrative procedures, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure (Types 1-3). The ministerial signature serves to authorize the regulations but does not constitute a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a Hybrid gazette.
